mapper.insert: INSERT INTO payments ( order_id, toss_order_id, payment_key, idempotency_key, method, amount, status, provider_status, failure_code, failure_message ) VALUES ( #{orderId}, #{tossOrderId}, #{paymentKey}, #{idempotencyKey}, #{method}, #{amount}, 'READY', #{providerStatus}, #{failureCode}, #{failureMessage} )
mapper.select: SELECT id, order_id, toss_order_id, payment_key, idempotency_key, method, amount, status, provider_status, active_paid_order_id, active_ready_order_id, failure_code, failure_message, requested_at, approved_at, canceled_at, created_at, updated_at FROM payments WHERE order_id = #{orderId} ORDER BY id
mapper.update: UPDATE payments SET status = 'DONE', payment_key = #{paymentKey}, method = #{method}, provider_status = #{providerStatus}, approved_at = #{approvedAt}, failure_code = NULL, failure_message = NULL WHERE id = #{paymentId} AND status = 'READY'
UPDATE payments SET status = 'ABORTED', provider_status = #{providerStatus}, failure_code = #{failureCode}, failure_message = #{failureMessage} WHERE id = #{paymentId} AND status = 'READY'
UPDATE payments SET status = 'EXPIRED', provider_status = #{providerStatus}, failure_code = #{failureCode}, failure_message = #{failureMessage} WHERE id = #{paymentId} AND status = 'READY'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO payment_cancellations ( payment_id, idempotency_key, cancel_amount, cancel_reason, request_type, requested_by, status ) VALUES ( #{paymentId}, #{idempotencyKey}, #{cancelAmount}, #{cancelReason}, #{requestType}, #{requestedBy}, 'REQUESTED' )
mapper.select: SELECT id, payment_id, idempotency_key, cancel_amount, cancel_reason, request_type, requested_by, status, active_requested_payment_id, transaction_key, failure_code, failure_message, requested_at, canceled_at, created_at, updated_at FROM payment_cancellations WHERE id = #{cancellationId}
mapper.update: UPDATE payment_cancellations SET status = 'DONE', transaction_key = #{transactionKey}, canceled_at = #{canceledAt}, failure_code = NULL, failure_message = NULL WHERE id = #{cancellationId} AND status = 'REQUESTED'
